_baseline_note: R-MFDN A cell (AudioSet AST 86M, fine-tuned), P2 fold f0, reference-free (i3), visibility-aligned; BSC $S/runs4f/f0/A_base (114 min train, 2h04 wall). Test: ACC 65.02 / AUC 86.06 / mAP(tts,rvc) 99.97, tts 100.00, rvc 99.94.

factor._note: absent = AST (paper encoder). melcnn = MelCNN in encoders.py: 5 stride-2 conv blocks 32-64-128-256-256 + GAP + Linear->512, 1,110,240 params, from scratch, same 1024x128 AST fbank input. C0's audio stream.

hypothesis: A 1.1M from-scratch CNN on the same fbank keeps f0 test mAP(tts,rvc) at the AST level (tts and rvc AP >= 99.5) and binary AUC within +-1 of 86.06, because the audio cue is codec-level and shallow (carrier analysis; from-scratch encoders and WavLM-Large gave the same tts/rvc numbers).

budget._note: AST run was 114 min train; CNN forward is ~1% of AST FLOPs, data loading (mp3 decode + fbank) may dominate

launch.cluster: BSC MN5 acc, code $S/code/idforge-final, template experiments/launch/c0_cell.slurm
launch.flags: EXP=E003_a_melcnn_f0 FOLD=0 MOD=A EXTRA='--audio-encoder melcnn' sbatch --export=ALL,EXP,FOLD,MOD,EXTRA experiments/launch/c0_cell.slurm

results._expected: $S/runs_c0/f0/E003_a_melcnn_f0/{results.json,test_results.json}; pulled to experiments/runs/c0/f0/E003_a_melcnn_f0/ after the run
